Copyright.AdditionalInfo: TRANSFER FUNCTIONS PROVIDED IN GEOGRAPHIC COORDINATES. Data were collected by the Geological Survey of Canada. The S line data were acquired for Pan Canadian Oil company by Phoenix Geophysics and donated to the Geological Survey of Canada. All data were collected in geomagnetic N/E. Impedance and tipper data were subsequently rotated by Paul Bedrosian to geographic north to produce final EDI files with all data in geographic north.
